title: Basically Shadow Warp
description: Recreates the shadow warp scroll from hypixel skyblock as an item
body:
## What does this mod do?
**This sword adds a sword, which basically combines 2 of my mods**, (_Basically Implosion_ and _Basically Gyrokinetic Wand_)

## Well, we dont know what your mods do, explain please!
Alright, alright
Now this mod **adds a sword which when you** _first right click_:
- **It teleports all of the mobs in a 10 block radius to the block you right clicked (also works on entities but is kinda broken)**

  When you right click for the second time:
- **It kills all mobs in a 10 block radius**

## Like all of your other mods, isnt this mod too op?
No, it also requires a lot of resources to get it,


# Notes:
- Made in MCreator
- Made solo
